config.label: Maximum number of concurrent managed processes (default: 10)
config.description: Maximum number of concurrent managed processes (default: 10)

config.label: Output buffer size per stream in bytes (default: 1048576)
config.description: Output buffer size per stream in bytes (default: 1048576)

config.label: Milliseconds to wait between graceful and forced termination (default: 5000)
config.description: Milliseconds to wait between graceful and forced termination (default: 5000)

config.label: Seconds before exited processes are auto-removed
config.description: Seconds before exited processes are auto-removed. 0 disables cleanup (default: 1800)

config.label: Global cap on bytes returned by the output tool
config.description: Global cap on bytes returned by the output tool. 0 means unlimited (default: 0)

config.label: Comma-separated allowlist of executable names
config.description: Comma-separated allowlist of executable names. When set, enables security mode with direct exec (no shell). Unset means security disabled.

config.label: Comma-separated regex patterns to reject in commands
config.description: Comma-separated regex patterns to reject in commands. Only applies when security is enabled.

config.label: Audit log destination
config.description: Audit log destination. 'true' writes to cwd, 'temp' writes to OS temp dir, or a directory path. Unset disables audit logging.
